4	describe('parse', () => {
5	  test('parses a single row of unquoted fields', () => {
6	    expect(parse('a,b,c')).toEqual([['a', 'b', 'c']])
7	  })
8	
9	  test('splits rows on newlines', () => {
10	    expect(parse('a,b,c\n1,2,3')).toEqual([
11	      ['a', 'b', 'c'],
12	      ['1', '2', '3'],
13	    ])
14	  })
15	
16	  test('keeps commas inside quoted fields', () => {
17	    expect(parse('name,quote\nAlice,"hello, world"')).toEqual([
18	      ['name', 'quote'],
19	      ['Alice', 'hello, world'],
20	    ])
21	  })
22	
23	  test('treats doubled quotes inside quoted field as a literal quote', () => {
24	    expect(parse('id,note\n1,"she said ""hi"""')).toEqual([
25	      ['id', 'note'],
26	      ['1', 'she said "hi"'],
27	    ])
28	  })
29	
30	  test('keeps newlines inside quoted fields', () => {
31	    expect(parse('id,bio\n1,"line one\nline two"')).toEqual([
